source.rank_semantics: FrOfUse is the Yarxi kanji frequency index; smaller positive values mean more frequent use.

sampling_rule.ordering: Within each fixed rank interval, sort by ascending SHA-256(seed + ":" + character).
sampling_rule.candidate_pool: The ordered lists below are frozen before the acceptance run. They retain primary-GIF-absent candidates so the provider can exercise its confirmed fallback path or record a fail-closed outcome.
sampling_rule.replacement_rule: For each stratum, attempt candidates in listed order and accept only exact article + pixel-validator VERIFIED outcomes. Stop after 10 verified assets; a failed candidate is replaced by the next listed candidate in the same stratum.
